versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Rats pass stat gains along a chain of touching units, halving at each step.
Where news starts and who stands next to whom matters, and any tribe's units can join the chain.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Pinned down the unclear rules: how ties and links shape the Knot, where Wendelin's news starts, how Chimneys stack, what Ilse repeats, and the Huddle no longer re-splits.
Small early Gossips (Crier, Seconder) now reach a neighbour, and the Thirty-Two re-broadcasts what it hears, so it isn't redundant beside the Rattenkönig.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
The Thirty-Two now repeats only news heard while recruiting, so Speaker's fight Gossip can't turn permanent and compound; the Knot keyword says a tie adds just the tied unit.
Cold-Shed Litter ties its Stray to itself to teach ties at Tier 1, and Roll-Caller counts every unit in the Knot to reward mixed boards.
